name: Formosa

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official SIT Catastral v2 HTML loaded. It identifies public parcel information and a WMS/map-service route; current Next.js JavaScript was inspected.

Current viewer configuration exposed the public proxy and Parcelas MapServer layer: https://sit.formosa.gob.ar/sit.public/proxy.ashx?https://10.10.0.36/arcgis/rest/services/Formosa/Parcelas/MapServer.

ArcGIS layer metadata returned polygon geometry, active definition expression PAR_ESTADO='A', native display field PAR_NOMENCLATURA, native fields including PAR_PARTIDA and PAR_NOMENCLATURA, and a POSGAR 1994 Argentina Zone 6 projected extent.

Bounded anonymous exact-point query using geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=3857, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, where=PAR_ESTADO='A', outFields=PAR_NOMENCLATURA,PAR_PARTIDA, returnGeometry=true, and outSR=4326 returned one feature with PAR_PARTIDA=23290 and one polygon.

Official IDEF page identifies the official map viewers, SIT Catastral, and the Dirección General del Catastro Territorial as central office/custodian context; no separate parcel feature request was needed after the SIT layer was qualified.
Official provincial procedure identifies Dirección General del Catastro Territorial and urban/rural parcel survey procedures; it is procedure evidence, not a parcel feature response.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Query output EPSG:4326; layer metadata native extent is POSGAR 1994 Argentina Zone 6.
schemaAndCrs.inspection: Safe query requested only PAR_PARTIDA and PAR_NOMENCLATURA plus geometry. One polygon was sanitized to properties {id: '23290'}; source-specific attributes remain metadata only.

qualification.reason: A real official parcel response was obtained, but this research packet does not admit or qualify a runtime adapter.
